name: vexriscv-rv32im_cached-caches
description: VexRiscv rv32im_cached / rv32ima_linux L1 caches (GenFullNoMmu sizes): 4 KiB, 32-byte lines, one way. The data cache is write-through and does not allocate on a store miss.

approximations: no wrong-path or redo fetches in the model
fixed latencies, not the RTL bus timing
